# SPD-015 — Hold a lead that returns with its own children unrecorded

## Brief
Law 9 binds every parent, but after [[SPD-008]] the `Stop` hook covers Spud's turn only: a lead can return `done` while a child it spawned has a final stop recorded and no `outcome`, and nothing holds it. Extend the `SubagentStop` hold in `bin/spud` so a member whose own children have `stopped_at` set and no `outcome` is held once with the list ("record each with `spud --as <id> member finish …`"), the same shape as the Result hold and the Law 9 block, `stop_hook_active` letting the second pass through. Evidence: Desiree's proposal 1 on [[SPD-008]] (`hook_stop` lists members whose parent is Spud or no longer alive; `hook_subagent_stop` checks only the member's own `result`/`blocked`).

Done when: a red-first test in `tests/test_hooks.py` shows the hold once and the release, the suite stays green, and a headless probe with a lead and one background child shows the lead held until it finishes the child.

## Size, persona and model decision
One engineer, no children. **Model: opus**, the engineer's default tier. The fable override written at creation (enforcement, same as [[SPD-008]]) is withdrawn at Eric's word, 2026-09-12: no Fable on any work for the rest of the day, weekly usage about half spent. Headless probes run on haiku. Spud reads the diff and reruns the suite at return.

## Outcome
Done. The finishing rule now binds every parent, not only Spud: `SubagentStop` holds a member once when its own Result or Blocked is missing, when a direct child of its own returned with no verdict, or when a direct child is still alive (running, or planned and never spawned). One block, children first, with the exact `spud --as <agent_id> member finish …` for each child and the proposals clause; `stop_hook_active` lets the second stop through, `stopped_at` is still stamped at the final stop only, status is never touched by the hook, and a member with no children of its own gets the old Result message byte for byte. Built by [[SPUD-015/Pompadour|Pompadour]] (01, engineer, opus) on branch `worktree-spd-015-lead-hold`: 13 red-first cases in `LeadHoldTest`, the suite green at 220 in Spud's own run, and four haiku sessions. The exploration run against the old code is the evidence for the still-alive clause: a lead spawned a background child, ended its turn at once, and the child ran on for 35 s, recorded its Result and stopped unrecorded with its notification going to the main session. Under the new code the same scenario holds the lead, which waits inside its turn, records the child and is let go. Left: the four prose lines in `CLAUDE.md` (Law 9, the Ledger v1 hooks bullet, the brief template Limits line) and `.claude/agents/spudagent.md` (Finishing, Sub-agents step 3), which Spud updates when Eric merges the branch; [[SPD-018]] carries the same blind spot in Spud's own `Stop` hook.
